column1: # Functions that meet the "verified" stage (docs/PROGRESS.md): already documented (re/documented*.tsv) and
# checked at runtime in PPSSPP following docs/verification/ppsspp-plan.md. Applied to Ghidra by
# tools/ghidra/ApplyVerified.java (tag VERIFIED), which ExportFunctions.java turns into the "verified" status.
# Columns are tab-separated: program (Ghidra program name, e.g. BOOT.BIN or rel_duel_eng.prx), address,
# results file (docs/verification/results/<date>-<session>.md) and a one-line summary of what was observed.

column4: summary
M1 (Session 0) found the three-instruction leaf in place; A1 logged every write of the variable it returns, 0x09e2d1e8: values 0-5 and 7 (6 never) in the documented order
A5: after a face-up Normal Summon from the hand bit 17 of player word +0x120 (0x09e2a648) was set (0x00330000), and the next begin-turn command cleared it
A6: break at entry with (side 0, slot 2), v0 at the jr ra 0x09c0a624 was 1500 alone and 1800 with a +300 equip, matching the screen
A9 (staged, edits recorded): break at entry with 4 queued Broww triggers; the chain resolved links 4, 3 (opponent) then 2, 1 (turn player), the documented sort, without asking for an order
A10: called during the CPU's Main Phase for the human's set cards; returned 0x1748 (Level 3 stand-in) for set monster 0x1c6c and 0x16a7 for set spell 0x1581, never the real ids
A1: the phase writes 0->1->2(->3->4)->5 came from 0x09dbc3ec inside it, for commands 10-15 posted by both sides
A3: command 0x24 a=200 reason 1 lowered side 0 LP at 0x09e2a528 from 8000 to 7800; Session B: the tag pair's LP fell by the logged 0x24 amounts (300, 2100, 1300)

Execute log at entry in Sessions A, B and D: (op, a, b, c) as documented, bit 15 set on every CPU command, and each posted command then ran in posting order (phase, LP, chain and marker effects observed)
D1: entered for side 1 (CPU, no response) then side 0 after each link up to 15; the human path called begin_player_input(0, 5); no window was offered once the chain had 16 links
D1: logged (side 0, mode 5) from the response window after each link and (side 0, mode 2) when the chain was over and the Main Phase menu returned

A1/A2: phase write 5->7 from 0x09dbc1f8 inside it at each turn change, turn side toggled 0/1 and turn counter +1 per turn; Session B: in the tag duel it called tag_duel_swap_active_duelist for the new side
B1: entry/return logs at four turn changes: hand, deck and Extra Deck counts exchanged with the waiting area, LP and Graveyard unchanged, duelist kinds swapped with the waiting kinds
B2: the only start entry that ran for a story tag duel; afterwards the tag flag 0x09e2d1fc was 1 and both sides got their 5-card opening hands
A10: called with side 0 (human) during the CPU's turn for hand indices 0, 5 and 3; returned 0 each time (hand not public, no reveal marker)
C4: called with a0 = -200 for each sandwich; DP at save +0x0fdfc went 1768 -> 1568 -> 1368, written from 0x08854bcc inside it
C1: after each time change wrote calendar +0x04, +0x10, +0x0c, +0x14 and +0x1c with the documented formulas (t 2, 3, 8, 50) and never +0x08, +0x18, +0x20
C1: leaving a map advanced the slot counter t from 2 to 3 (write at 0x08eaacd8), then the calendar was recomputed
C1: End the day moved t from 3 to 8, slot 1 of the next day (write at 0x08eab0e0), then the calendar was recomputed
C1/C2: logged mode 2 when leaving a map, 6 for End the day, 1 on map entry; on new days it called pick_sandwich_seller every day and assign_daily_spots only on the change to day 7 (Monday)
C2: ran only on the change to Monday (day 7); the pairing order at field block +0x1c changed and stayed fixed on days 1-6; the first pair (characters 3, 120) held neighbouring spots 334/335
C2: records of characters 3, 120, 5 and 122 held the location, cell and direction of their spot table entries, and +0x58 the day index of the reading (6, 6, 1, 1)
C3: called as (2, +10) after a taste-3 gift and (2, +20) after a taste-2 gift; Jaden's points u16 at 0x08ab560e went 200 -> 220
C3: ran when a sandwich was given to Jaden (character 2); the queued reaction changed the points by the taste value, +10 (taste 3) and +20 (taste 2)
